source_policy: Deduplicate the established seed masters from batches A and B. Do not recompute Floquet spectra, select profiles, fit a predictive model or compute p-values.
block_construction: For N=400 use 12-value nested block means; for N=600 use 8-value nested block means. Local standard deviations use population ddof=0.
candidate_rule: A metric must have at least 6 distinct values among 8 seeds and either strictly increase or strictly decrease along seed=1,0,6, matching or opposing the jump-change counts 0,4,6. Otherwise it is unordered and not shortlisted.
coarsening_rule: For block metrics, record whether N=400 and N=600 produce the same strict direction. This is a descriptive robustness label, not independent validation.
selection_boundary: Candidates are exploratory only. No correlation, regression, causal attribution, predictive accuracy, p-value or statistical significance is computed or implied. The driver-change count is 4 for all three comparison seeds and cannot supply an ordering.
